text:
Market GREEN (VIX 15.3), but Nasdaq futures are -0.8% and the 10-year yield is at 5.19%, which hurts expensive growth stocks. Expect a softer open. 13 trading days left to Oct 30.
Plan: one buy, no sells. AMD (#1): it has pulled back about 3% from yesterday's planned price, so you get a better entry. Use a limit of $597 and an 8% stop near $547. About 1.4 shares, roughly $840. Earnings Nov 3, so it gets reviewed before then.
CRWD (held): rose to #2 in the ranking. Down 3.6% on cost. Keep the stop at ~$251 (CDR ~77.80 CAD). No top-up needed today.
SNOW (held): +9.1%, but it fell from #5 to #12 and is out of the model's top 5. The system sells only at the Monday review, but SNOW is right at its first target ($362). Locking in the gain today is reasonable and frees cash for the top-ranked names.
MU (#3), PANW (#4) and NET (#5) are strong too, but they are not on this week's list, so the system won't buy them mid-week.
The system's simulated account is at -3.9%, your account +0.3% and the S&P +0.9%. Reaching +20% needs the cash invested in winners. Don't chase, and keep the stops.
